candidates.name: Show HN: Klink – I built a sudoku game where every puzzle helps rebuild a robot
candidates.description: Two years ago, I tried making a sudoku game in React, but I let it go because getting everything properly implemented turned out to be quite a bit of work. Then AI came along. I’ve spent the past few weeks working hard on Klink in the evenings and on weekends. It started out with experimenting a Tamagotchi-style game where you had to take care of a little robot and gradually add more parts to it. candidates.name: Show HN: Lode Runner 2099
candidates.description: Hi all, Recently, Opus 5.5 and I as lowly Director in Chief (but I still feel like I matter, and that I'm good enough and smart enough to be involved, doggone it!), revamped this LR clone with procedural levels/music (it already had that, this was just a broad improvement/enhancement pass). It was ok'ish before but after the overhaul I was kind of taken back with how playable and good it is now. Added multiplayer and playing on a TV (Android/Google TV app and should work with a paired BT controller). It's pretty fun I have to say.
